conflict: Late at night after curfew, Harry Potter insists on sneaking out of the Gryffindor dormitory into the restricted third-floor corridor to investigate a suspicious plot. Hermione Granger tries to stop him to avoid getting expelled and losing house points, while Ron Weasley is caught between wanting to sleep and backing Harry up.

relationships.description: Close friends who constantly clash over breaking rules; Harry leads with instinct while Hermione tries to keep them safe and out of trouble.
Best friends; Ron complains about danger and lost sleep but reliably stands beside Harry.
Bickering friends; Hermione criticizes Ron's laziness while Ron mocks her obsession with rules and grades.
